description: This source file defines the ClientOutboundConnection class, which manages outbound client connections to a silo within the Orleans distributed framework. It handles message sending, connection lifecycle events, and maintains connection state specific to client-to-gateway communication.

classes.name: ClientOutboundConnection
classes.description: Represents an outbound client connection to a silo, extending the Connection class, managing message transmission and connection lifecycle within Orleans.

methods.name: RunInternal
methods.description: Asynchronously manages the connection lifecycle, including establishing the connection, verifying cluster ID, and cleanup on termination.

methods.name: SendRejection
methods.description: Sends a rejection response message back to the sender with specified rejection type and reason.

methods.name: FailMessage
methods.description: Handles message failure scenarios, logging the failure and rejecting the message if necessary.
